items.title: Frank Naundorf Interview, 1965-02-25
items.q: And then there was a couple of people who called it, like Gerhard Kowell.

ctx.x: And then I had to do this. That were English? Or were those English?

No, they came out of the book. Where? That was the one who Bill Haley made in 1943. And then the Climax label. And then I bought me also Bank Johnson-Platten. And we had then also small groups. And then there was a couple of people who called it, like Gerhard Kowell.
